note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; the rule text is the author's illustrative text, not a statement of any law. Only the supplied datum and its dependent geometry change; the old value stays traceable and no outcome is shown.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: Fictional delivery: the lens isolates the porch; the datum 'on the porch bench' is swapped for 'on the window sill (hypothetical)', then only the flag and parcel move from the bench to the sill; the context returns with a Δ marker and the struck old value.

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: a fictional equipment return in which the datum moves the box from the wall parcel box down to the bench (the lens shows a downward move rather than a sideways one); higher zoom, right-hand lens placement, two issues and different context labels.
